name: Second Brain — Local Web Clipper
description: Local-first, zero-cloud web clipper for Second Brain. Captures quotes and pages with verifiable SHA-256 snapshots directly to 127.0.0.1.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; connect-src http://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none';
